_comment: English voice-over for the supplier payment video, keyed by caption title (plus intro/outro). Written for the ear: ERP71 is spelled out; bill numbers are read as words.

narration.intro: Welcome to E R P seventy-one. Here's how to pay a supplier what you owe them, all of it or just part, and match the payment to their bills.
narration.Open Supplier Payment: In the sidebar, open Purchase, then Supplier Payment.
narration.Every payment in one list: Every payment you make to a supplier is listed here. That includes payments made on the purchase itself, like this one, which was paid when the purchase was posted.
narration.Start a new payment: Click New Supplier Payment. The direction is already set to pay to supplier. Receive from supplier is only for a refund they send back to you.
narration.Pick the supplier: Now choose who you're paying. The payable balance is everything you owe them, here eight thousand one hundred and twenty taka. Below it are their open bills, with what's still due on each one.
narration.Enter the amount, split it across bills: We're paying five thousand taka. First, clear the older bill, three thousand three hundred and twenty taka on purchase seven. The other one thousand six hundred and eighty goes against purchase eight. The line underneath counts down, so you know everything is matched. Then pick how you paid, here from the bank, and add the bank reference as a note.
narration.Record the payment: Click Record payment. It's saved, what you owe goes down, the bills are marked paid or part paid, and the entry is posted, from the bank account you chose. Anything you don't match to a bill stays on account, as a prepayment.
narration.It’s on the list: The new payment is on top of the list, with its own number, ready to view, edit, or print.
narration.What you owe went down: Open a new payment for the same supplier to check. The payable is now three thousand one hundred and twenty taka. Purchase seven is gone from the open bills, and only the rest of purchase eight is left.
narration.outro: So, to recap. Open Supplier Payment, click New Supplier Payment, pick the supplier and check their open bills, enter the amount and split it across the bills, then record the payment. Bills paid, and your books are straight.
